data_boundary: No transaction outcome later than 2025-11-30 is read or evaluated. October-November are already used development data, never a fresh holdout.
baseline: Per product-store arithmetic mean of recorded daily positive non-cancelled units over trailing 91 calendar days, after first recorded activity; multiply by horizon. This is a fair interpretation of a 13-week mean, not the customer's exact method.
primary_metric: mean absolute error of seven-day aggregate product-store units; equal weight per origin-pair
primary_population: 336 policy product-store pairs; fixed non-overlapping Sunday weekly origins June 29 through November 23, 2025; omit September 21/28 to reproduce producer separation
selection: Minimum seven-day MAE over June-September development; October-November stability diagnostic only. Candidate remains baseline for release if meaningful robust superiority is unproven.
secondary: policy lead+review aggregate MAE at fully observable origins

engineering_recording_criterion.paired_origin_block_bootstrap: 95% percentile lower bound of relative MAE gain must be positive; fixed seed 60; 10000 resamples
engineering_recording_criterion.status: engineering criterion, not supplied business threshold, ROI, cost or service guarantee; business approval absent

recording_readiness: Requires independently evidenced untouched December, frozen protocol/code/data/rule/predictions, gate approval, and one post-freeze holdout result. Missing evidence fails closed for recording only. Ordinary application results are not blocked.
holdout: December 2025 outcomes are forbidden in this development run; do not inspect, score, select or tune on them. Unavailable provenance means no valid final holdout claim.
